extras: Pro features require GitHub Sponsors sponsorship ($5/month or $15 one-time).
intentEvidence: Iconize issue #380 asks for "a separate option to have the addon write to frontmatter". This plugin is that option.
problem: Iconize stores file icons in a separate data file, preventing them from being used as note properties.
summary: A plugin that copies file icons set in Iconize into note properties and keeps them synchronized.
